title: The pillars of Islam
intro: The five main Islamic duties every adult Muslim must do.

learn.html: The pillars of Islam are the main Islamic duties that every adult Muslim man and woman must do. There are five:

Allah, the Most High, commanded these main duties in the Qur’an as a strict obligation. Believing in them and doing them is the condition for being a Muslim – that is why they are called the pillars (conditions) of Islam.

learn.title: Iman and Islam
learn.html: The difference: the pillars of Iman we only believe; the pillars of Islam we believe and do. By doing them we show obedience to Allah (SWT), hoping for His reward.

learn.title: 🎭 Game
learn.html: Stand in a circle and take turns saying the pillars of Islam in order. Whoever makes a mistake steps out of the circle. Who is the winner?
